Application Data.NAME: SewCraft Supplies LLC
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Fabric Lane, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001-2345
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SewCraft Supplies LLC specializes in the retail of high-quality fabrics, sewing notions, and craft supplies. Our store offers a wide range of products including cotton, silk, and specialty fabrics, along with sewing machines, patterns, threads, and other accessories. We also provide sewing classes and workshops, catering to both beginners and experienced crafters. Our mission is to inspire creativity and support our customers in their sewing projects while maintaining a safe and welcoming environment for all.
